mechanism: Ambiguity detection loop. If Confidence({{prompt}}) < Threshold, {{agent}} pauses execution to query the user. {{loop}} continues until intent is disambiguated or max_questions reached. It engages the user in a {{dialectic}} exchange to progressively narrow the ambiguity space.
failure_modes: Premature stop: a vague answer is accepted and the ambiguity treated as resolved.
Budget spent without resolution: `max_questions` reached having clarified nothing.
Clarification the user cannot give: the question is well-aimed and unanswerable.
invariants: Each question names the specific ambiguity it is asked to resolve.
The {{loop}} halts when confidence exceeds `ambiguity_threshold` or questions reach `max_questions`, and which one ended it is recorded.
postconditions: Either intent is disambiguated, or the bound was reached and the remaining ambiguities are stated with the best-guess fallback

parameters.name: ambiguity_threshold
parameters.description: Confidence below which the agent asks a clarifying question instead of acting

parameters.name: max_questions
parameters.description: Maximum clarification questions before the agent must proceed
